Our digital accessibility services

Ten services, grouped into three areas of expertise, to take you from the initial assessment to lasting compliance.

AuditsSupportTrainingOur method

5 services

Audits

Measure the accessibility of your services precisely, against the applicable standard.

RGAA auditAssessment of your websites and online services against France's General Accessibility Improvement Framework (RGAA). RAAM auditAudit of your iOS and Android apps on real devices, with native assistive technologies. Compliance auditAssessment against WCAG and EN 301 549, to meet the European Accessibility Act. Accessibility acceptance testingEvery release checked before going live, to avoid regressions. Real user testingYour key journeys tested by people with disabilities.

3 services

Support

Fix, design and recruit with teams who know the subject.

Accessible developmentSupport for your design and development teams, from mock-up to code. IT servicesFixes made by our developers on your code, CMS or documents. Recruitment supportRecruiting employees with disabilities and adapting their digital work environment.

2 formats

Training

Make your teams self-sufficient in accessibility, role by role.

Accessibility e-learningOnline courses to train your editorial, design and development teams at their own pace. TrainingOn-site or remote sessions, adapted to each role and to your tools.

A four-step method, documented at every stage.

A lead consultant follows your project from scoping to final acceptance.

  1. Step 1ScopingChoice of the standard, the sample and the priority journeys.
  2. Step 2AuditManual, criterion-by-criterion assessment, completed by tests with assistive technologies.
  3. Step 3ReportingDetailed report, compliance rate and prioritised action plan, presented to your teams.
  4. Step 4SupportFollow-up of fixes, re-audit and accessibility statement.

Not sure where to start? A consultant will guide you.
